# `aitbc exchange start-trading`

Start trading for a specific pair with optional initial price and liquidity.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc exchange start-trading [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--pair` | text | — | yes | Trading pair symbol (e.g., AITBC/ETH) |
| `--price` | decimal | — | no | Initial price for the pair |
| `--base-liquidity` | float | `10000` | no | Base asset liquidity amount |
| `--quote-liquidity` | float | `10000` | no | Quote asset liquidity amount |
| `--exchange` | text | — | no | Exchange name (if not specified, uses first available) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc exchange start-trading --pair <pair>
```
